title: Release of Information and Follow-on Actions after Defects were Found on 26 MRT Trains
what_it_is: Release of Information and Follow-on Actions after Defects were Found on 26 MRT Trains

sections.label: Train cracks detected after operation
sections.summary: LTA found no cracks when it took possession of the trains and tested them in 2011; hairline cracks appeared about two years after operation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) did not detect any cracks when it took possession of the trains and when it was testing them in 2011.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The hairline cracks appeared only about two years after they were put into operation.

sections.label: Manufacturer responsibility for defective bolsters
sections.summary: The manufacturer took full responsibility, committed to replace bolsters made in Japan, weld them to new car bodies and re-assemble trains in China, all fully paid by the manufacturer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Second, the manufacturer took immediate and full responsibility for the defects, committed to fully replace the bolsters with a new set made in Japan, weld them to the new car bodies and re-assemble the trains in China.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: All these remedial actions would be fully paid for by the manufacturer.

sections.label: Compensation case left to LTA Board
sections.summary: Whether there is a case to pursue compensation is left to the LTA Board to assess.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Whether there is a case to pursue compensation, I leave it to the LTA Board to assess.

sections.label: Defective bolsters on 26 trains
sections.summary: 26 trains were found to have defective bolsters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As Members know, 26 trains were found to have defective bolsters.

sections.label: Fleet expansion plan by 2019
sections.summary: The plan was to expand 124 deployed trains to more than 150 by 2019, requiring the North-South East-West line fleet to expand from 140 to 170-plus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Our plan was to expand 124 deployed trains to about more than 150 by the year 2019; which requires the North-South East-West line to expand its fleet from 140- to 170-plus.

sections.label: New bolsters manufactured in Japan
sections.summary: A new set of bolsters is being manufactured, this time not in China but in Japan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Meanwhile, a new set of bolsters are being manufactured, this time not in China but in Japan.

sections.label: Releasing two trains at a time
sections.summary: Two trains could be released at a time later next year when more new trains come in, speeding completion to 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The possibility is that we can release two trains at a time in the later part of next year, when more new trains come in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: With that, we could speed up the whole process to complete by 2019.

sections.label: Bolster cracks and replacement
sections.summary: Cracks were not a major safety concern but the bolsters will be replaced, made in Japan, with warranty restarted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Although the cracks are not of major safety concern, they decided that a defect is a defect and they will replace it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Although the contract was for the bolster to be made in China, they said, from now on, all the bolsters will be made in Japan.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: When they are sent back to Singapore, the defects liability and warranty clock will be restarted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: In fact, we have now a very prolonged warranty period for the product.

sections.label: Kawasaki seeks new battery supplier
sections.summary: Kawasaki noted the testing result and decided with its Chinese partner to get a new battery supplier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Again, Kawasaki took note of that testing result and immediately decided with their Chinese partner to get a new supplier of the batteries.

sections.label: Lessons on timely LTA information
sections.summary: A question asks whether LTA should have given timely information, noting one-year defects liability and four-year extended warranty.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The other question I have is: are there any lessons, with the benefit of hindsight, on whether LTA should have given timely information as and when the issue cropped up?

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: There is a defects liability of one year, then an extended warranty of four years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: In this instance, they decided that they will replace the entire bolsters, including the car body, and then restart the clock.

sections.label: Warranty applies to bolsters and car bodies
sections.summary: The extended warranty and defects liability period apply only to the bolsters and the car bodies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: To answer the 	Page: 22 query, the extended warranty and the defects liability period only apply to the bolsters and the car bodies.

sections.label: Cracks in Bukit Panjang LRT
sections.summary: The only other times cracks appeared were in the Bukit Panjang Light Rail Transit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The only other times where cracks appeared were in the Bukit Panjang Light Rail Transit (LRT).
